The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] '''Missile Trooper''' was a specialized soldier who carried a low-impact [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]]. The soldiers could also become '''Armored Missile Troopers''' and carry two launchers. The [[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]] served the Alliance,<ref name="SW:GB" /> which was formed in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Rebel" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were outfitted at [[Barracks/Legends|Troop Centers]].<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

As part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], eight Armored Missile Troopers joined in the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Seizure of Coruscant]]<ref name="CC" /> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Missile Troopers appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.
